description: This file defines macros and function prototypes for managing UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) configurations within the BBFDM (Broadband Firmware Data Model) context. It includes functions for initializing, freeing, getting, setting, adding, deleting, and iterating over UCI sections and options, as well as macros for simplified usage.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_uci_ctx
methods.description: Initializes the UCI context within the BBFDM context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_uci_ctx
methods.description: Frees the UCI context within the BBFDM context.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_buf
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value into a buffer.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value as a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_fallback_def
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value with a fallback default.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_by_section_buf
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value by section into a buffer.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_by_section
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value by section as a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new section to a UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_delete
methods.description: Deletes a UCI option or section.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_commit_package
methods.description: Commits changes to a UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_walk_section
methods.description: Iterates over sections of a specific type in a UCI package.
